name: Simple Shear-Warp Algorithm
definition: A shear-warp volume rendering method that does not use acceleration data structures (except for the runlength-encoded intermediate image for early ray termination), resulting in a low memory footprint.
summary: The Simple Shear-Warp Algorithm is a CPU-based volume rendering method that shears geometry to align rays with principal axes, distinguished by its lack of acceleration structures and use of run-length encoding for early termination.
